items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He along with Don DeMicheal, who died many years ago, were among the people that I respected most as writers

ctx.x: Dan Morgenstern, one of the major voices in jazz writing, one of the most honest people I’ve ever known. He along with Don DeMicheal, who died many years ago, were among the people that I respected most as writers, people that I knew could set aside their biases and write in an honest way, or at least state their biases up front, so you knew, when you were reading them, what those biases were before you started to read. And he’s somebody who I think is a great scholar. I can remember calling him when I got ready…
